entities: Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012

qa_pairs.question: Which specific legal provisions are cited in the SROs to grant public interest exemptions regarding both customs duties and Value Added Tax/Supplementary Duty?
qa_pairs.answer: The SROs exercise powers under Section 25(1) of the Customs Act, 2023 for customs duties and Section 126(1) of the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012 for VAT and Supplementary Duty to grant exemptions in the public interest.
